CPU vendor/family/model/stepping/processor id where available without admin
CPU manufacturer/brand from /proc/cpuinfo or Windows CIM
actual OS CPU instruction flags and microcode when available
NumPy compiled baseline and dispatch and actual CPU flags
NumPy show_runtime BLAS and SIMD details
full input corpus source and public hashes
per_source_per_original_training_seed_st: original native source action-public episode receipt exact SHA
original first current public 23-input float64 SHA
native original read dot f@g[1] SHA
native original u dot f@g[0] SHA
native original full MR34I4 source logit u after +0*read float64 SHA
native original first public prediction exact original 8wide np.exp sigmoid SHA
comparison_method: All 20 previously consumed training reset seeds × two independent original source families × 8 real OS/mode jobs. Record complete 8-element binary64 hex for source stages per seed, so first differing stage, index and bits can be established without new first-use. Compare within same OS/mode replica, between OS at same mode, default vs disabled within OS. Do not use rounded prints.
qualification: Per-job diagnostic PASS requires exact original Git+source event SHA, initial source model SHA and clear actual CPU identity; any original logit drift is retained as FAIL-CLOSED original source-logit custody, but diagnostic must emit enough bytes to localize first divergent source stage. Original trained model portable checkpoint remains NO_GO even if logit matches.
